_comment: cryptship hardened seccomp profile. Starts from allow-all and denies the syscalls an in-container attacker uses to read another process's memory. Run: docker run --security-opt seccomp=deploy/seccomp.json ... Note: a container/host root can start a process OUTSIDE this profile (e.g. a privileged sidecar), so this stops a non-root / in-container attacker, not host root. Only a confidential-compute key provider stops host root.
